backend/main.mo: Defines catalog, style, order, and inquiry types with sample data and a date comparator for sorting orders.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries with related components, file paths, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten one‑line summaries for various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind base layers and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component rendering all site sections with intersection‑observer‑based active navigation.
frontend/src/components/branding/BrandLo: Renders the brand logo image with fallback to LogoPlaceholder on load failure.
frontend/src/components/branding/LogoPla: Provides a scissors‑icon placeholder box for branding when the logo image is unavailable.
frontend/src/components/catalog/CatalogC: Displays a style image with fallback UI when src is missing, invalid, or fails to load.
frontend/src/components/catalog/CatalogS: Fetches and displays catalog categories and styles with filtering, reconciliation, and image rendering via CatalogCardImage.
frontend/src/components/layout/Section.t: Simple layout wrapper giving sections consistent padding, container width, and optional background variants.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Renders the site footer with brand info, quick navigation links, contact details, and a credits link.
frontend/src/components/navigation/SiteH: Provides a sticky responsive header with brand logo, navigation links, and mobile menu handling.
frontend/src/components/navigation/TopCo: Displays a top bar showing phone and email contact shortcuts.
frontend/src/components/order/OrderNowSe: Implements the order form with style selection, measurement inputs, validation, and order submission.
frontend/src/components/order/SizeGuideP: Provides a collapsible size guide with measurement instructions and reference sizes.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Shows an about section highlighting tailoring features and service qualities.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Renders a contact section with contact info, inquiry form, validation, and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/sections/HomeHer: Hero section component with background imagery and buttons that smooth-scroll to order and catalog sections.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Exports static contact details including phone numbers, email, address, and business name.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, identity loading, and state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching catalog data, submitting orders, and submitting inquiries using the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles with custom OKLCH theme variables, fonts, and utility definitions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/state/selectedStyle.ts: Zustand store tracking selected style and clearing it if removed or excluded from the catalog.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration with custom colors, radius, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: JSON defining the project’s current website requirements, design notes, contact updates, image edits, and existing implemented features, plus known issues and fix requests. It serves as the authoritative state for ongoing build and maintenance.
